title: SwivelGrid Schema Column
description: Defines a single column in a SwivelGrid schema array. Pass an array of these objects to grid.schema.

key.description: Property name on each row object whose value is displayed in this column. Required.

sort.description: Initial sort direction for this column. Only one column is sorted at a time.

sortable.description: Whether clicking the column header triggers sorting. Set to false to disable.

type.description: Deprecated. Use cellTemplate instead. Only 'image' retains a visual effect in card/grid layout.

cellTemplate.description: Handlebars-style template for cell content. Available variables: {{value}}, {{row.fieldName}}, {{renderRating(value)}}, {{renderImage(value)}}, {{formatDate(value)}}, {{formatNumber(value)}}, {{formatCurrency(value)}}, {{capitalize(value)}}, {{truncate(value, 50)}}.

headerTemplate.description: Handlebars-style template for the header cell. Available variables: {{label}}, {{column}}.

cellClass.description: CSS class name(s) applied to the cell content wrapper. Requires CssClassesExtension. Function form (value, row) => string is not expressible in JSON — set via JS.

headerClass.description: CSS class name(s) applied to the <th> header cell. Requires CssClassesExtension.

rowClass.description: CSS class name(s) applied to the <tr> row. Requires CssClassesExtension. Function form (row) => string is not expressible in JSON — set via JS.

className.description: CSS class applied to the <td> element in table layout.

columnClass.description: CSS class applied to the entire column (both <th> and <td>).

minWidth.description: Minimum column width CSS value, e.g. '120px', '10rem'.

maxWidth.description: Maximum column width CSS value, e.g. '300px'.

width.description: Fixed column width CSS value applied as inline style to <th> and <td>.
